s.note: The crew shares a croissant without Emmet. Warm croissants with leg ham, gruyere and Dijon.
s.how: Split the croissants and spread the insides with mustard. Fill with the ham and most of the cheese. Brush the tops with butter, scatter over the rest of the cheese and bake at 180C until melted and crisp. Cut in half and serve warm.

s.note: Barry's plan for after work tonight. Sticky honey soy wings with a ranch dip.
s.how: Toss the wings with the honey, soy, garlic and paprika. Spread on a lined tray and bake at 200C, turning once, until sticky and dark. Stir the sour cream, mayo, chives and lemon juice together for the dip.
shop: 1kg chicken wings, tips off and jointed@Meat

m.note: The Kragle is set for Taco Tuesday. Spiced beef, tomato salsa, cheese and lime crema.
m.how: Brown the mince and onion, then stir in the cumin, paprika and tomato paste with a splash of water and simmer until thick. Mix the tomatoes and coriander with a squeeze of lime for the salsa. Stir the sour cream with the zest and juice of the other lime. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with lettuce, beef, salsa, cheese and crema.

m.note: Giant sausages and Emmet left behind. Thick pork sausages in buttered rolls with fried onions.
m.how: Fry the onions slowly in half the butter until soft and golden. Grill the sausages, turning, until browned and cooked through. Split and butter the rolls. Tuck in the sausages and top with onions, sauce and mustard.

w.note: No rules in Cloud Cuckoo Land. Vanilla ice cream, toasted marshmallow and rainbow sprinkles.
w.how: Simmer the berries and sugar until saucy, then cool. Scoop the ice cream into 4 tall glasses and spoon over the berry sauce. Toast the marshmallows under a hot grill or with a kitchen torch and pile them on. Finish with sprinkles and a wafer.

d.note: Larry the Barista charges Emmet $37. Thick hot chocolate with whipped cream and cocoa.
d.how: Heat the milk until steaming, then whisk in the chocolate and cocoa until smooth. Pour into 4 mugs, top with whipped cream and dust with cocoa.
shop: 1 tbsp cocoa powder, plus extra to dust@Pantry
